about.page.seoDescription: PEGASUS® is built on Presto Industries' tradition of handmade combs since 1977. Launched in 2012 as the first hard-rubber ebonite comb with Intelligent Flexinite® technology.
about.page.title: Mastery belongs to those who practise it
about.page.belief:
Mastery belongs to those with hearts full of passion, and those who find joy in perseverance. It's the quiet skilling up, day after day, which comes from the pursuit of perfection. It's a love of hair and the craft, carried through every hour of practice it takes to earn.

That is the foundation of PEGASUS®. That same passion drives us to create, to innovate, to shape every tool, comb, or brush, by hand, until it becomes a work of art. Every PEGASUS® comb is an expression of mastery, made to rest easy in your hands.

flexinite.page.seoTitle: Flexinite® Technology — PEGASUS® Hard Rubber Combs
flexinite.page.seoDescription: Flexinite® is the intelligent comb technology behind every PEGASUS® hard rubber comb — firm and rigid when cool, a controlled, gentle flex under heat.
flexinite.page.title: One comb, two advantages
flexinite.page.intro: Precision when you need control. Ease when you need flow.

qa.q: What makes PEGASUS® Flexinite® combs different?
qa.a: One comb, two advantages. Rigid at room temperature for precise, controlled cutting — then gently flexes under heat, gliding through hair without snagging during blow-dry, straightening, and styling. Most combs force stylists to choose between the two. Flexinite® doesn't.
Flexinite® is the intelligent comb technology behind every PEGASUS® hard rubber comb — engineered to stay firm and rigid when cool, then respond to heat with a controlled, gentle flex.

qa.q: Why does dual performance matter to a stylist?
qa.a: Precision and ease usually come from two separate tools. Flexinite® gives you both in one: sharp control for sectioning and cutting, seamless glide for detangling and finishing.

qa.q: Is it built for professional, daily salon use?
qa.a: Yes. Designed for salon-grade durability and comfort, it is a tool that holds up to the pace of professional work while still feeling considered in the hand.

qa.q: How does this support training and teaching?
qa.a: The rigidity when cool makes it dependable for teaching accurate sectioning and cutting technique. The flex under heat carries the same comb into finishing and styling lessons — one tool that follows a stylist from their first cut in school to working mastery in the chair.
A comb that adapts to what the moment calls for — precision when you need control, ease when you need flow. Mastery in Your Hands.
